messages:
Mia (Product Designer): dropped a compact prototype for the model catalog compare page: https://www.figma.com/file/def. Quick asks: table density vs readability, filter ordering, and making performance badges a11y-friendly. Thoughts?
Raj (Frontend): looks good. On density: collapse non-critical cols by default and add an expand caret per row. Keeps table scannable at 1280px.
Leah (Research): users liked summary rows + expand on demand. Also we should surface Recent/Starred as a sticky filter chip.
Ava (Design PM): for pinning, prefer inline toggle with small confirm toast + undo rather than modal. Less disruptive.
Mia (Product Designer): agree. Also badges must not rely on color alone. Add icon+text and ensure contrast >=4.5, and include sr-only metric text.
Raj (Frontend): will implement skeletons for badges and lazy-load details. Add aria-live for sort changes and aria-pressed on pin buttons.
Leah (Research): microcopy: "Pinned v2 to /checkout — Undo" worked well in tests. Make hit target >=40px.
design-bot: figma-snapshot: https://cdn.redwood.ai/design/snap-1742184000-compact.png
Ava (Design PM): action items: 1) add Recent/Starred chip, 2) collapse noncritical cols + expand rows, 3) inline pin + undo toast, 4) badge lazy-load + a11y. Prioritize 2,3,4 for next sprint.
Mia (Product Designer): I'll update the figma and post new snapshot. Thanks all!
